Good to know, thanks Winson. On power: the BS-4's supply is a Mean Well 100 to 240V with a 115/230V selector, so Malaysia's 240V is fine. The cord itself is listed as US or EU, and Malaysia uses the UK style Type G plug, so I've asked the team to confirm which cord goes in your box and get you a Type G one if we can.

They're on now, so stay in the chat; if you step away the answer comes to your email.

One thing in your favour either way, Winson: the cord is a standard detachable one into the power supply, so even in the worst case a local Type G cord plugs straight in. Ship date is still October 31.

When it lands, our Discord is the fastest place for setup help, JD and the community are in there daily: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Enjoy the wait, and the team will be in touch about the plug.
